''See also: [[Akura Justice Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Justice is an [[Archlord]] and a high-ranking member of the [[Akura clan]], serving as its First [[Gatekeeper]]. In this role, he is responsible for inspecting external goods brought into the presence of the head family to ensure they meet clan standards. An ancient figure with a long white beard, he has held his position since before [[Akura Charity]] was born and previously served as a mentor to [[Akura Malice]]. As one of only three [[Archlord|Archlords]] in the clan, he possesses significant power, including the ability to manipulate [[aura]] using [[soulfire]] and utilize [[shadow madra]] through the [[Path of the Chainkeeper]]. Justice has played various roles within the clan, from inspecting potential [[tournament]] representatives to defending portals and providing tactical support during battles. He has demonstrated the ability to use techniques like [[Strings of Shadow]] to reinforce others or engage in combat. Despite his authoritative and sometimes stern demeanor, he has shown concern for the clan's reputation and the safety of its members, occasionally acting as a guide or representative during official diplomatic encounters.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Justice is an ancient man characterized by a long beard. He can be seen wearing black gloves.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As the First [[Gatekeeper]] of the [[Akura clan]], Justice serves as a subordinate to the clan and acted as a mentor to [[Charity]] during her childhood. He is an [[Archlord]] who once defended a [[fortress]] [[portal]] by himself.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Justice is a distant cousin of [[Akura Charity]]. Additionally, Justice served as a mentor to [[Charity]] during her childhood.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A [[Sage of Twin Stars]], Justice utilizes [[shadow madra]] and the [[Strings of Shadow]] [[technique]]. He also employs [[soulfire]] to manipulate [[aura]] and uses specialized tools, such as a thorn-covered cap and a lifeline device, to perform various assessments.}}
